decisions.title: Chose Vue 3 over React
decisions.context: Team needed to build MVP quickly for social analytics dashboard. Team had more Vue experience than React.
decisions.decision: Selected Vue 3 with Composition API over React 18
rationale: Vue 3 Composition API provides similar benefits to React hooks
decisions.outcome: Reduced development time by 40%, MVP delivered 2 weeks early
decisions.lessons: Team velocity matters more than technology hype for early-stage products

decisions.title: MongoDB vs PostgreSQL
decisions.context: Needed to store evolving analytics data from multiple social platforms with varying schemas.
rationale: Flexible schema for evolving data models
Easier horizontal scaling for time-series data
decisions.outcome: Enabled rapid iteration on data models without migration overhead
decisions.lessons: Schema flexibility is critical when integrating with multiple external APIs

decisions.title: Multi-tenant Architecture
decisions.context: Building enterprise POS system for multiple business locations with data isolation requirements.
decisions.lessons: Database-per-tenant adds operational complexity but provides better isolation

decisions.title: Offline-First Design
decisions.context: POS systems must work during internet outages to avoid business disruption.
decisions.decision: Implemented offline-first architecture with local database sync
rationale: Businesses cannot stop during internet outages
decisions.outcome: Zero downtime during internet outages, 99.97% uptime achieved
decisions.lessons: Offline-first is essential for critical business applications

decisions.title: Virtual Currency vs Real Money
decisions.context: Deciding between real-money gambling app vs social casino with virtual currency.
decisions.decision: Virtual currency only (no real money gambling)
decisions.outcome: Launched in 150+ countries, no legal issues
decisions.lessons: Virtual currency model enables global scale without regulatory burden

decisions.title: Service Worker Strategy
decisions.context: Needed to implement offline support and caching for PWA.
rationale: Faster load times for returning users
decisions.lessons: Cache-first provides best UX for content-heavy PWAs

decisions.title: AI-Powered Job Matching
decisions.context: Job seekers overwhelmed by irrelevant listings, employers receive unqualified applications.
decisions.decision: Implement AI-powered job matching using OpenAI API
decisions.lessons: AI matching significantly improves user outcomes and engagement

decisions.title: WebGL vs Canvas API
decisions.context: Building image editor with real-time filters and effects.
decisions.lessons: WebGL essential for professional-grade image editing in browser

decisions.title: Custom Controls vs Native
decisions.context: Building video player with custom UI requirements and analytics.
decisions.decision: Custom HTML/CSS controls over native browser controls
decisions.lessons: Custom controls provide better UX and analytics but require more maintenance

decisions.title: Firebase vs Self-Hosted Backend
decisions.context: Building productivity app with real-time sync across devices.
rationale: Real-time sync out of the box
decisions.lessons: Firebase ideal for MVP and early-stage products with real-time requirements
